description: Two live smoke cases for the section-aware retrieval regression fixed on Attention Is All You Need.

cases.question: 《Attention Is All You Need》这篇论文的方法是什么？请概括 Transformer 的编码器、解码器和核心注意力机制。
cases.expected_answer: Transformer removes recurrence and convolution from sequence transduction. It uses a six-layer encoder whose layers contain multi-head self-attention and position-wise feed-forward sublayers, and a six-layer decoder that adds masked self-attention and encoder-decoder attention. Sublayers use residual connections followed by layer normalization. Its core attention is scaled dot-product attention applied through multiple learned projection heads, and sequence order is supplied by positional encodings.
required_concepts: attention-only encoder-decoder without recurrence or convolution
six-layer encoder with self-attention and position-wise feed-forward sublayers
six-layer decoder with masked self-attention and encoder-decoder attention
residual connections and layer normalization around sublayers
scaled dot-product multi-head attention and positional encodings

cases.question: 《Attention Is All You Need》这篇论文的结论是什么？
cases.expected_answer: The paper concludes that Transformer is the first sequence transduction model based entirely on attention, replacing recurrent encoder-decoder layers with multi-headed self-attention. It trains faster than recurrent or convolutional alternatives and achieved new state-of-the-art results on WMT 2014 English-to-German and English-to-French translation. The authors planned to extend it beyond text, study local restricted attention for large inputs such as images, audio and video, and make generation less sequential.
required_concepts: first sequence transduction model based entirely on attention
replaces recurrent layers with multi-headed self-attention
faster training than recurrent or convolutional architectures
new state of the art on WMT 2014 English-German and English-French translation
future work on other modalities, local attention and less sequential generation
